edits.new: The ten criteria are new to this run

edits.old: And no event is published by the payment branch
edits.new:
And no event is published by the payment branch

  Scenario: AC8 The ownership, placeholder, version, timeout, rule, value and personal-data rules of section 8 hold (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules BR1, BR2, BR3, BR4, BR7, BR8, BR9 and BR10 of section 8
    When the baseline and a draft of it are checked against each rule
    Then each operation, event and table has one owner and each other row names its owner
    And a consumed row with no published name carries its placeholder and gap identifier and no path
    And an additive change is a minor version and a removal, a rename, a type change or a new required element is a major version
    And every consumed row has one hop, a 2 s timeout and a breaker, and no chain
    And the rule package is referenced and no rule table of this service is declared
    And the term length, the reminder point, the statuses, the codes and the thresholds are referenced by identifier and version
    And no personal data and no person's name appear in any element, fake or example

  Scenario: AC9 A retried or timed-out consumed activity is bounded by its declared budget (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed row of rwb-case or rwb-payment with its 2 s timeout and its breaker
    When the call is retried or exceeds the 2 s timeout
    Then the retry rule of the row is read from the baseline and not from the code
    And the timed-out call answers 503 in the problem envelope of AC5

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the status identifiers and the allowed transitions the baseline references by identifier and version
    When a draft changes a status along a transition the model does not allow
    Then the compatibility check refuses the draft
    And the baseline writes no status
